Card - Class in com.example.miniproyecto3.model
Represents a single playing card, defined by its Rank (2-10, J, Q, K, A) and Suit (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades).
Card(Rank, Suit) - Constructor for class com.example.miniproyecto3.model.Card
Creates a new card with the given rank and suit.

Checks whether the match has reached a winning condition, i.e. only one non-eliminated player remains.

collectForRecycle() - Method in class com.example.miniproyecto3.model.TablePile
Returns every card in the pile except the one currently on top, intended to be returned to the deck when it runs out of cards.
